items.issue: describe block uses 'toWireAddress' rather than the '#functionName' convention the testing best-practices doc specifies for pure-function unit tests

The 'comprehensive' scenario's animalIdentifiers array (and its input fixture at ~656-674) exercises only 4 of the 6 per-unit identifier fields the mapper now maps (microchip, passport, tattoo, earTag, horseName, permanentAddress) and none of the two AC-required fallback fields animalIdentifierIdentificationDetails / animalIdentifierDescription — a repo-wide grep finds no obligation of either name anywhere in src/server/app, so AC 'Each per-unit identifier field (tattoo, horse name, identification details, description, permanent address) reaches the aggregate when entered' is unimplemented, not just untested.
items.fix: Either add the missing animalIdentifierIdentificationDetails/animalIdentifierDescription obligations + mapper wiring (in identifiers.js / species-entry.js) and extend this fixture's animalIdentifiers units to cover them, or split this AC point into a follow-up ticket and note the gap in EUDPA-368's description/AC.
items.notes: Won't Fix — the scenario's two units already cover all six fields between them (passport, tattoo and ear tag on the first; microchip, horse name and permanent address on the second). Identification details and description were removed as part of EUDPA-500, so it looks like the ticket hadn't caught up with that change.
